improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
improve.coach: 40% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
improve.coach: Unchanged around 40%. Time to tackle it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet. 60% of matches. Your calling card.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership. 40% of matches. Elite habit.

coach.intro: tuxedo_slide, the numbers from 15 matches don't lie, and they're mostly kind.
